transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

Well... I suppose... I just don't really have the push I used to. For things. Like choir... or my quilting. I don't go visiting folks much anymore either. Most days I just... sit at home. I keep the TV on low. I know people are expecting me to show up, but... I just stay put.
How long have you been feeling this lack of push and pulling away from your activities?
I suppose... it's been a while now. Started around the time I stopped working at the school office. That was... a little over two years ago, I think. It just sort of... built up since then.
During these past two years, have there been any times when you felt back to your normal self for more than a few weeks?
No... I don't think so. It's just been... steady, I guess. Nothing really changes.
Along with losing that push, have you also been feeling down, sad, or empty on most days?
No... I don't think I'm sad. I just... I don't know. I'm just there.
How have your energy levels been over these past two years?
I don't know... just normal, I suppose. I'm not really doing much to get tired anyway.
How has your sleep been over these past two years?
It's alright, I guess. I just... go to sleep. Nothing really to say about it.
How has your appetite been over these past two years?
It's fine, I guess. I just... eat when it's time to eat. Nothing really different.
